sonar_ground_consumer.meaning: MovementPlane rotation applied to local +Y. The native sonar compares it with world +Z to detect a differently oriented plane. This is not camera up or the collision contact normal.

callback_safety.restriction: Only inspect the original authenticated controller view on its callback thread. The component is already read by that callback. Never walk engine memory from the Wasm/worker reader. Match view slot, chunk, row and entity both before and after the copy.

ActiveDistrict.layout: selector returns last 16-byte stack entry +8; empty stack returns object+0x20; first uint32 is key

district_leads.evidence_limit: The selected key resolves content used by sonar. Its writer, uniqueness namespace, persistence across restart, map coordinate origin and lifecycle are not yet established. Do not expose it as a stable zone, frame or campaign ID.

limitations: Static registration and producer/consumer tracing establishes layout and intended movement-plane semantics, not successful live observation during a gravity transition.
The existing player generation is transient observation continuity; world pointers and ECS handles are private runtime identities, not save/campaign lineage.
No native world create/destroy epoch producer, coordinate rebase/zone boundary, campaign creation/load/rollback identity, or persistent marker restoration key is established here.
The component lookup and repeated copy reject observed identity/data changes; they are not cross-thread synchronization or ABA protection.
The adapter only permits a reviewed current hotfix profile. Older supported profiles need independent verification before this service can read them.

save_coordinate_leads.finding: The native saved transform structure serializes a separate level-bundle identifier alongside its transform. This is a stronger coordinate-namespace lead than the selected district key.
save_coordinate_leads.unresolved: One source setter is now traced to a loading callback, but whether its requested bundle is the active coordinate frame, its uniqueness and persistence, transform rebasing/streaming behavior, and campaign lineage remain unproven. Do not expose it as a public persistent marker key.

producer.identifier_copy: 0x227b500..0x227b542: dereferences pointer at view+0x108, reads optional uint64 at pointee+0x90 and validity byte+0x98, writes value or zero to saved transform+0x20.
producer.context_mapping: The capture assembles the entity view followed by the declared environment view. Its +0x108 source is consistent with the GameState smart-pointer entry in the autosave scheduler signature; a loading callback writes the optional field, but its coordinate-space meaning remains unproven.
producer.phase_limit: Autosave declares reads of SharedBundleState and GameState. The existing movement callback declares only PhysicsScene, FixedTime and GlobalIDToEntityMap environments; copying this source in that callback would add an unproven scheduler dependency.

campaign_leads.finding: containerId and prefix are serialized strings. No creation-time immutable campaign identifier or load/rollback lineage has been traced; do not use these strings or save slots as a campaign identity.

selection.source: Cached header record strings at +0 and +0x28; selection compares record fields at +0x58/+0x68. Exact mode and ordering semantics are not established.
selection.limit: Current save selection can be cleared and replaced. Serialization is not evidence of immutable campaign lineage. A creation-time identity and its load/rollback/NG+ behavior remain untraced.

save_id_creation.input: Active slot byte from request state +0x19; the helper formats the zero-extended byte.
save_id_creation.scope: Branches creating a save ID use a slot-derived container name and a separate save-kind prefix. The slot formatter has no campaign identity input.
save_id_creation.limit: A save slot can be reused; deriving mod campaign scope from this container name would merge unrelated playthroughs. This trace does not establish that every possible custom save prefix has the same lifetime.

fields.0x58: Value returned by helper0x31dd0d0 during capture; not a proven creation-time campaign token.
fields.0x68: Incremented SavegameState order counter copied into each header.
fields.0x7c: newGamePlusPlaythrough: copied 16-bit source value; request flag+0x1b increments it unless already0xffff.
fields.0x81: isInitialNewGameSave: initialized zero; request flag+0x1b sets it to one.
fields.0x10: jumpPoint string, including the initial-save request branch; a spawn target, not a lineage token.
fields.0x60: activeBundleID; initial-save branch copies the nested source integer at +0x40. A content/loading identifier, not established campaign lineage.

header_creation.limit: The order counter changes per capture, slots can be reused, and NG+ progression is a bounded counter. The persistent-global apply path restores the counter independently of these header fields. Neither path establishes immutable campaign lineage or rollback semantics.

load_leads.parser: 0x2199f90 parses the persisted initial-new-game byte and NG+ word. These are header metadata, separate from the persistent-global counter apply path.
load_leads.initializer: new_game_plus::initialize_database reaches0x2334f40; if world-state Database+0x98 is set, instruction0x2334fa7 clears NewGamePlus+0xc2. This is not yet a proven unique new-campaign boundary.
load_leads.copy: Instruction0x233a1b4 in0x233a0b0 copies an existing NewGamePlus environment counter into an allocated environment clone. It is not a saved-header load consumer.
load_leads.next: Establish authoritative campaign creation and save-extension lifecycle before defining campaign-scoped mod storage. Do not infer lineage from counter changes.

loading_request_lead.game_state_slot: callback argument 0 points to a GameState pointer
loading_request_lead.source: The loading callback copies the final ID of a requested bundle vector into the optional GameState field during selected flow branches.
loading_request_lead.save_correlation: The autosave writer at 0x227b500 reads the same optional GameState field through a smart-pointer slot at capture view+0x108, copies player transform to the saved structure and writes the ID or zero at +0x20.
loading_request_lead.observation: A ten-pointer loading callback and two-pointer save writer are observed only at verified direct callers and exact October hotfix prologues. Each observed invocation forwards unchanged. Captures stop admitting calls after ten minutes; event storage and sampling are bounded.
loading_request_lead.limit: The requested bundle is not proven to be the active coordinate frame, persistent zone, or immutable campaign identity. Capture is diagnostic only; no public persistent marker API follows.

runtime_evidence.scope: Bounded native observations on this executable fingerprint; no public identity contract.
runtime_evidence.saved_transform_copy: Observed native save results match the captured transform and optional bundle field.
runtime_evidence.optional_identifier: Successful save writes occur with the optional bundle identifier both present and absent. Absence must remain distinct from a valid identifier whose value is zero.
limitations: The selected loading context is not established as a persistent zone or coordinate-frame identity.
The loading sample budget can finish before later save writes; lack of a corresponding loading record does not prove that no transition occurred.
Reload persistence, rollback, coordinate rebasing and campaign identity are not established by these observations.

saved_transform_restore.selector: 0x215c8c0; call at 0x215cd70 to wrapper 0x21633b0, which tailcalls 0x227b550
saved_transform_restore.arguments: Saved 40-byte transform/bundle record, and borrowed restore view. The leaf forwards no new arguments and returns void.
gates: Restore-view byte +0x210 must be zero; its wider semantic name is not established.
Saved bundle at saved+0x20 must be nonzero.
GameState optional bundle from *(view+0xd8), then +0x90/+0x98, must be present.
Saved and current bundle values must match.
saved_transform_restore.accepted_path: Copies the saved 32-byte transform to temporary arguments for writers 0x1836800 and 0x1836ad0, then sets a row-selected byte through view+0xb8 and view+0xa0. Rejected paths return without those writes.
saved_transform_restore.significance: The stored identifier participates in native admission of a saved transform. It is more than a serialization label. This establishes a specific restore compatibility check, not global coordinate identity.
saved_transform_restore.diagnostic: Optional bounded observer copies entry inputs at the authenticated direct caller through the tail wrapper, forwards unchanged, and records eligibility separately from native return. It does not read or modify destination state.
unresolved: Actual application of the transform and player ownership require live evidence.
Equality does not establish unique campaign lineage, save rollback policy, or absence of coordinate rebasing.
Same-map instances and multiple playthroughs cannot be distinguished using this check alone.
saved_transform_restore.observed_entry_gate: A returned native invocation had matching nonzero saved/current bundle values but restore-view byte +0x210 rejected the operation. Bundle equality alone is therefore insufficient even at an observed restore entry. No transform application or campaign identity is established.

capture.increment: If view+0x138 is set, increment the saved value unless already0xffff. The wider flag lifetime is unproven.

apply.chunk_selection: 0x215ccdf..0x215ccf9 selects persi-global;0x215cd03 tests the returned chunk pointer
apply.completion: 0x215cd1a sets a per-chunk flag after the apply helper returns. This is not global load completion.

persistent_global_playthrough.relationship: The persistent-global path precedes the separate player transform apply call at0x215cd70. Each chunk has its own presence check; ordering alone does not prove a transaction or successful player restoration.
persistent_global_playthrough.evidence: Static capture, serialization and apply path on the fingerprinted executable; no live load, rollback or NG+ execution observed for this counter.
persistent_global_playthrough.limit: A saturating 16-bit progression count can repeat across independent campaigns. It is neither an immutable lineage token nor an SDK campaign identity.

save_chunk_lifecycle.evidence: Static current-profile instruction and ownership trace; no custom save data written or gameplay-qualified.

extension_limits: Named byte buffers provide a possible extension point, not an established custom-chunk API.
Nonmatching names are skipped by this specific reader; whole-pipeline unknown-chunk retention or deletion is unproven.
Capture begins with fresh lists. This does not prove that the storage backend removes files absent from the request.
Campaign creation, rollback, NG+ migration, cloud/container replacement, mod removal and schema compatibility need independent evidence before campaign-scoped storage can be exposed.

concrete_backend.scope: Static installed Steam executable path. Other distribution backends and live disk/cloud behavior are not qualified.

limits: The ordinary inspected Steam write path operates on supplied names and has a separate removal operation. Higher-level container replacement, removal triggers and live persistence still need qualification.
No game save was modified. Full request lifecycle, new-game/container replacement, cloud recovery and malformed-extension compatibility remain unverified.

final_application.retention_evidence: No sweep of unmentioned names was found in the ordinary tag0 handler and final application sequence. This is evidence against an automatic wipe in this specific path, not an end-to-end retention guarantee.
final_application.external_boundary: Interface calls at virtual offsets0x1c8,0xa0 and0x1d0 surround final application. Their exact contracts, cloud behavior and disk durability are not established from offsets alone.
